name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: October Week 5 - Sources and Lists
description: Practice words for lists, credible sources, and citation.

words.definition: A group of related items stored together.
words.example: The list stored the sources used for the blog.
Each item in the list was one website title.

words.definition: A position number in a list.
words.example: The index showed the position of a source in the list.

words.definition: The website, image, or text location used for a blog fact.
words.example: The source provided the fact used in the paragraph.
A credible source had an author and a clear date.

words.definition: Information that shows where a source came from.
words.example: The citation included the website name and link.

words.definition: Using someone else's work as if it were your own.
words.example: Copying a paragraph without credit was plagiarism.
